wins: Performed comprehensive network scanning to map available hosts and open ports, establishing a reliable initial reconnaissance baseline.
Captured SSH service banner information and stored it for follow-up enumeration, enabling pattern recognition for potential credential reuse.
Documented all successful vendor and version data points to transition into targeted exploitation planning.
fails: Could not escalate privileges after initial foothold due to lack of sudo rights and missing local exploits.
Repeatedly timed out on credential brute-force attempts because of aggressive lockout policies on the SSH service.
Failed to harvest valid credentials for lateral movement, leaving the post-exploitation phase untouched.
key_outcomes.summary: Recon phase yielded actionable intel, but the operation stalled before privilege escalation due to insufficient credential access and lack of exploitation follow-through.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts consistently blocked by absence of sudo rights or exploitable binaries.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration and version-specific nmap scripts
Run smb-enum-shares and smb-enum-users via nmap to identify accessible resources and users

skill_cards.if_condition: When no valid credentials yet and SSH lockout detected
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to credential gathering via password-spray on web login endpoints before brute force

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
Consistent value in identifying accessible SMB resources

next_experiments.title: Focus on credential harvesting via OSINT-derived user lists
next_experiments.description: Integrate automated OSINT tools to expand user list prior to targeted credential spraying and pivot from SSH lockouts into alternative services.

next_experiments.title: Deploy local privilege escalation checks with linPEAS
next_experiments.description: After obtaining shell, run linPEAS with output capture to quickly identify misconfigurations or sudo rights for escalation.

next_experiments.title: Validate alternative lateral movement paths using SMB relay testing
next_experiments.description: Leverage smbrelayx.py with internal authentication to test relay potential and avoid direct brute-force exhaustion.
